title: Pre-planning my writing
summary: Hey #edu407 #edu305 #edu407 here is an example of my pre writing. From a two minute podcast to a two hundred page book I always start the same way. Few people can just start writing and keep any organizational flow. Plan your trip. Pre-planning is the GPS of writing
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Hey #edu407 #edu305 #edu407 here is an example of my pre writing.

From a two minute podcast to a two hundred page book I always start the same way. 

Few people can just start writing and keep any organizational flow. Plan your trip. 

Pre-planning is the GPS of writing
